name: Abinadab
bio: Abinadab was a son of Saul — called "Ishvi" when Saul's sons are listed in 1 Samuel 14:49, but "Abinadab" at his death in 31:2; 1 Chronicles 8:33 and 9:39 also call him "Abinadab," and he is traditionally understood to be the same man under two names. When the Philistines fought Israel at Mount Gilboa and pressed hard after Saul, Abinadab died alongside his brothers Jonathan and Malchishua, all four — father and three sons — falling on the same day (1 Samuel 31:1-6).
